a.lede: The Nvidia scandal has raised questions over whether advanced AI chips ended up in China, despite US restrictions.
a.title: Suspected China spy linked to Nvidia's ex-boss left in 2025, Megaspeed says

b.lede: The Singapore-based company is suspected of helping to ship high-end AI chips from tech giant Nvidia to China, violating US export rules.
b.title: US government confirms investigation into tech firm Megaspeed
